notes.title: Patch 1.1.51 updated!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Added the Archive Repairment function: The early version before patch 1.1 has encountered a problem of “a soft lock when players quit in the middle of the story plot forcibly”, now you can simply punch the “Archive Restore” button to fix the problem. “Archive Restore” appears only when the system detected a glitch.  
[*] Load the archive from the demo version will automatically grant “Hero Arrives” and “Eat the Rich” achievements.  
[*] Fixed the bug where pressing the attack button could suspend Yang Xiuqing’s ballad performance.  
[*] Fixed the faulty display on the “Controls” chart when plugged in with some controllers.  
[*] Fixed the NPCs (Uncle and Auntie Niu) missing when players quit in the middle of the “Threaten Li Hong” plot forcibly. 
[*] Fixed the faulty dialogue display in some plots. 
[*] Fixed the bug where Matsumoto Yuitsu carries abnormal light effect along with the “Lucky Charm” equipped.  
[*] Fixed several faulty displays for the character’s name. 
[*] Players can customize the keyboard setting normally now.  
[*] Fixed the localization issues within different languages. 
[*] Fixed the bug where there is a chance to carry the stolen weapon from Boss to the street.  
[*] Fixed the SFX anomalies in Boss fight with Courtesan.  
[/list]


[h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Increased the rate of stealing omamori after equipping with the “Lucky Charm”.

[*] Fixed a soft lock when players quit in the middle of the story plot forcibly. 
[*] Fixed a bug where the model of A-Guai overlaps the one of Ms. Dong in Jiangyue Lou.  
[*] Fixed a bug where selecting the Gentleman Thief difficulty will cause a save file set to Wanted Outlaw difficulty to also change difficulty setting.
[/list]  

 

[u][b]Improvements[/b][/u] 

[list]
[*] Adjusted dodge range when the last boss slashes their sword. 
[*] Adjusted the health points of the last boss. 
[*] Increased the drop rate of items in the last boss battle. 
[*] Increased the rate of stealing three types of wine from the homeless for Mr. Chuang. 
[*] In the latest patch, the three types of wine required by Mr. Chuang are “Takasago Beer”, “Miziko Sake” and “Kaoliang Fire Liquor Label”. 
[*] When seeking the wine required by Mr. Chuang, a homeless person who has the target object will light up.

notes.title: The Legend Of Tianding Announcement
notes.content:
[h1]They’ll Never Take You Alive! [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32940668/cef5dbf9375534d10d9671c810c9cddfb1bce82a.gif[/img]

[h3]We are thrilled to announce The Legend of Tianding, a fast-paced side scroller character action game exploring the life of Liao Tianding, the legendary Taiwanese folk hero![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32940668/903eb7a2377e6e5628eabfd836cfb1cdb75d1010.gif[/img]

Explore Colonial Taiwan at the turn of the century, as you rob the rich, feed the poor, and fight against the darkness gripping the very heart of Taipei.

[previewyoutube=IFQzjTv9pPA;full][/previewyoutube]

•	Play as Taiwan’s legendary “Robin Hood”. Rob the rich to feed the poor, and teach the oppressors to pick on someone their own size! 
•	A master thief relies on his tools: Use a tanto, a waist sash, and lightning-fast Kung Fu to battle your enemies in style. 
•	Steal your enemies’ guns, blades, axes, and more, all with their own unique movesets and properties. 
•	A comic book art style depicting the Dadaocheng area of Taipei as it looked like in the 20th century. 
•	Equip different magic talismans to augment your abilities and tailor Liao Tianding to your fighting style! 
•	Take a break from rebellion and play a game of Four Color Cards, a traditional Taiwanese board game.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32940668/0927e8c1b7a84f8daa130382aa632bea96c58e2e.gif[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1406850/The_Legend_of_Tianding/
